The '''Shella system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Shella (Tapani)|Shella]]. It was located in the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector's]] [[Melantha Province]], between [[Bilios]] and [[Rianon system/Legends|Rianon]].
